create.name: Daniel Foor
create.bio:
Daniel Foor is an American ritualist, writer and teacher of ancestor reverence and practical animism, and the founder and director of Ancestral Medicine, an organisation that runs courses, in-person intensives and a practitioner training. He holds a doctorate in psychology and once worked as a marriage and family therapist, and his ritual training comes from several living lineages: he is an initiate of the Yoruba Ifá and Òrìṣà tradition, having travelled to south-west Nigeria four times, and he has also learned from Rinzai Zen, Islamic Sufism and the old European pagan ways of his English and German forebears. He is a practising Muslim.

His central method, Ancestral Lineage Healing, teaches people to first make contact with wise, well ancestors and then, with their help, to repair troubled family lines and care for the restless dead. He set this out in his 2017 book Ancestral Medicine, which has since been translated into more than ten languages. Since 2004 he has guided well over a hundred multi-day ancestor rituals in many countries and mentored a large circle of practitioners. Alongside ancestry he teaches about relating to the Earth and other-than-human beings, grief and dying, and ritual safety, and he links this work to cultural repair and decolonisation. Since 2022 he has lived with his family in Andalusia, close to Granada.

courses.title: Ancestral Lineage Healing
courses.description: His foundational twelve-week online course in making contact with wise ancestors and working with them to repair a family line, with recorded lessons and live group calls. The January 2027 round starts on 5 January.
courses.price: Early registration $375 USD; Standard $550 USD; Reduced $445 USD

courses.title: Care for the Dead and Dying
courses.description: A self-paced series of four recorded lessons on accompanying someone before, during and after death, approached as a soul-level and cross-cultural practice rather than a medical or religious protocol.
courses.price: Supporter $120 USD; Standard $95 USD; Reduced $65 USD

courses.title: Spirit Contact for Beginners
courses.description: A four-part self-paced introduction to relating safely and directly with spirits of place, animals, plants and ancestors, suitable for newcomers and for people making sense of earlier experiences.
courses.price: Supporter $120 USD; Standard $95 USD; Reduced $65 USD

courses.title: Practices for Grieving and Heartache
courses.description: A self-paced course of teachings and simple rituals for meeting loss with an open heart, for anyone on a spiritual path and for people in helping roles.
courses.price: Supporter $120 USD; Standard $95 USD; Reduced $65 USD

free_resources.title: Foundations of Ancestral Healing
free_resources.description: A free recorded primer on how ancestral healing actually works, and a good first step before the full course.

free_resources.title: Caring for the Recently Deceased
free_resources.description: A free talk on how the living can show love and care for someone who has just died, treating death as a passage rather than only an end.

free_resources.title: Boundaries, Protection and Ritual Safety
free_resources.description: A free recorded teaching on keeping clear boundaries and staying safe when doing ritual and spirit work.

free_resources.title: Remembering Purpose
free_resources.description: A free equinox teaching with practices for renewal and for reconnecting with a sense of purpose at soul level.

free_resources.title: Keeping Your Practice Alive
free_resources.description: A free ninety-minute talk on keeping a spiritual practice going through distraction, flagging motivation and life changes.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube @ancestralmedicine 4,740 subscribers (Data API, 10 Nov 2026; his organisation's channel, which he founded and directs); Instagram (instagram.com/danielfoor) and Facebook not read (off limits). Total ~4.7k → local_hero.
flags: No Omega mention on own site (home, bio, courses, book, contact pages): listed without the link. Omega page not opened: eomega.org returns 403 to us (6 Nov 2026).
Email info@ancestralmedicine.org is his organisation's general inbox (published on the contact page with a form).
Base: his bio says he lives in Andalusia in the Sierra Nevada foothills near Granada, Spain; recorded as Granada.
Regional: Granada, Spain, where Spiritpedia has few or no teachers.

His bio and courses frame the work in terms of decolonisation, race and 'American imperialism', and the course list includes 'Inhabiting the Times' and 'The Mob & the Medicine' (cancel culture). Social-justice framing, not political commentary as such; those items not listed. Owner may want to look.

YouTube channel and videos belong to Ancestral Medicine (his organisation); the videos chosen are teachings and talks where he appears to be the main teacher, but individual video descriptions were not checked.
Ancestral Lineage Healing January 2027: the page says main calls will be anchored by Ancestral Healing Practitioners; Daniel developed the course and recorded the lessons.
Book publisher innertraditions.com returned 403 on 10 Nov 2026 (after reading its robots.txt); not retried, so no ISBN and no book listed.

Course and channel use the words 'healing' and 'medicine' in an ancestral and ritual sense, not a medical one. 'Rituals for Healing Trauma' and 'Possession, Addiction, and Belonging' left out under the health rule.
Photos: two crops from the same 2024 portrait on his own site; identity clear (named on his bio page).
left_out: Book Ancestral Medicine: Rituals for Personal and Family Healing (2017; site links to Inner Traditions): ISBN not on his own site and the publisher page (innertraditions.com) refused us (403).
Foundations of Ritual (8 Mondays from 23 February, rounds dated 2025-26) and Animism & Earth Reconnection (Tuesdays from 21 July): latest dates shown have passed.
Ancestral Lineage Healing Intensive, Costa Rica, 27-31 January 2027 ($1720 to $2700 USD): page does not say Daniel leads it in person.
Rituals for Healing Trauma; Possession, Addiction, and Belonging: condition-named titles (health rule).
Inhabiting the Times; The Mob & the Medicine: cultural and political framing.
Courses led mainly by other teachers (Writing with the Dead, Tending the Witch Wound, Ancestral Healing for Beginners): not his own teaching.
Reflections on Pandemic Year One (video): pandemic-themed, left out to be safe.
